title: Functional brain signatures of successful cognitive aging
title_zh: 成功认知老化的功能性大脑特征
abstract: Cognitive aging trajectories vary markedly. While many older adults experience gradual decline in memory and executive function, some maintain high cognitive performance well into advanced age. Understanding the neural mechanisms underlying this variability carries important implications for early detection of unfavorable aging trajectories and the development of interventions. Here, we review functional brain signatures associated with successful cognitive aging in humans, integrating evidence from functional magnetic resonance imaging and electroencephalography within a unified conceptual framework of brain maintenance and compensation. Across both modalities, evidence increasingly links successful cognitive aging to the preservation of youth-like neural dynamics, while the contribution of compensatory neural recruitment remains empirically contested and methodologically difficult to establish.
abstract_zh: 认知老化轨迹差异显著。许多老年人在记忆和执行功能方面逐渐下降，而有些人则能保持高水平的认知表现直至高龄。理解这种变异背后的神经机制，对于早期发现不良的老化轨迹以及开发干预措施具有重要意义。本文综述了人类成功认知老化相关的功能性大脑特征，将功能性磁共振成像和脑电图的证据整合在大脑维护与代偿的统一概念框架内。两种模式的证据都越来越表明，成功认知老化与保持年轻人的神经动力学有关，而代偿性神经招募的作用在实证上仍然存在争议，且在方法学上难以确立。
